characters.name: Elara
characters.description: A lone engineer maintaining the failing dome.
characters.motivation: Keep the bay habitable long enough for rescue.
characters.goal: Repair the failing battery before it dies.
characters.flaw: Refuses to admit the battery cannot be saved.
characters.internal_conflict: Hope versus the certainty of entropy.
characters.external_conflict: The failing battery and the empty moon.

abilities.name: Systems Diagnostics
abilities.description: Can read power-grid telemetry by ear.

characters.arc: Elara learns that survival sometimes means letting go.
